claim_boundaries: One disabled 600-second capture does not establish causation or eliminate an intermittent fault.
Two-core quota is a limit, not reserved CPU cores.
Skipping begin also skips refresh writes and reset-cause capture, and changes linked code layout.
Disabled firmware reset_cause=0 is an uninitialized software value, not reset-register evidence.

"""Campaign-local driver: change only this job's container CPU quota."""
import base64
import concurrent.futures
import io
import os
import json
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'firmware/tools'))
import run_input_isolation as rig
name, cores, cases, seconds = sys.argv[1:]
cores=float(cores)
p=ROOT/'doc/results/raw/watchdog-sdk-20260927'/name
p.mkdir()
build=Path(os.environ['SDK_COMPARISON_BUILD'])
manifest=json.loads((build/'build-manifest.json').read_text())
firmware=(build/'firmware.ino.hex').read_bytes(); rig.verify_hex(firmware,manifest)
settings={'AUX_INPUT_CAPTURE_SECONDS':seconds,'AUX_INPUT_RUNTIME_HEALTH':'1','AUX_INPUT_SDK_CASES':cases,'EXPECTED_HARDWARE_SERIAL':'20428100','EXPECTED_BUILD_ID':manifest['source']['build_id']}
package_bytes=io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(package_bytes,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
 for f in sorted((ROOT/'daq_api/src/thingdone_daq').rglob('*.py')): z.writestr(str(f.relative_to(ROOT/'daq_api/src')),f.read_bytes())
encoded=base64.b64encode(package_bytes.getvalue()).decode()
if os.environ.get('RIG_WIRE') == '1':
 settings.update({'AUX_INPUT_CASE':'INPUT_COMBINED','AUX_INPUT_RATE_PROFILE':'4','AUX_INPUT_RELEASE_FIXED_1MHZ':'1','AUX_INPUT_CPU_MHZ':'450','AUX_INPUT_RUN_DIAGNOSTIC':'0','AUX_INPUT_TEMPERATURE':'1'})
 source=(ROOT/'firmware/tests/rig_aux_input_capture.py').read_text()
else:
 source=(ROOT/'firmware/tests/rig_release_sdk.py').read_text()
if os.environ.get('SDK_WATCHDOG_DISABLED') == '1':
 original = '    assert health.watchdog_enabled, f"watchdog not enabled/validated at {phase}"'
 assert source.count(original) == 1
 source = source.replace(original, '    assert not health.watchdog_enabled and health.watchdog_timeout_ms == 0, f"watchdog unexpectedly enabled at {phase}"')
if os.environ.get('SDK_OBSERVE_LOSS') == '1':
 source=source.replace('    ADCBlock,', '    UnexpectedStreamGapError,\n    ADCBlock,', 1)
 source=source.replace('                    except Exception:', '                    except UnexpectedStreamGapError as error:\n                        evidence["diagnostic_only"] = "continue after strict gap errors; never qualify as PASS"\n                        evidence["gap_exceptions"] = evidence.get("gap_exceptions", 0) + 1\n                        if evidence["gap_exceptions"] <= 8:\n                            evidence.setdefault("gap_examples", []).append(str(error))\n                        continue\n                    except Exception:', 1)
 source=source.replace('                assert not losses.has_loss, repr(losses)', '                evidence["observed_losses"] = dataclasses.asdict(losses)\n                evidence["parser_counters"] = dataclasses.asdict(daq._reader.parser_counters)\n                evidence["failure_status"] = dataclasses.asdict(daq.status())\n                assert not losses.has_loss, repr(losses)\n                assert not evidence.get("gap_exceptions"), "observed gaps"', 1)
if os.environ.get('SDK_CAPTURE_REJECTED') == '1':
 source=source.replace('def main():', 'rejected_frames = []\nfrom thingdone_daq.protocol_v2 import IncrementalCompatibleFrameParser\noriginal_record_corruption = IncrementalCompatibleFrameParser._record_corruption\n\ndef record_corruption(parser, category):\n    if len(rejected_frames) < 4:\n        header = parser._pending_header\n        length = header.total_length if header is not None else 44\n        rejected_frames.append({\n            "category": category,\n            "frame_hex": bytes(parser._buffer[parser._scan_start:parser._scan_start + length]).hex(),\n            "bytes_received": parser.bytes_received,\n            "frames_decoded": parser.frames_decoded,\n        })\n    original_record_corruption(parser, category)\n\nIncrementalCompatibleFrameParser._record_corruption = record_corruption\n\ndef main():',1)
 source=source.replace('    evidence["host_after"] = host_cpu()', '    evidence["rejected_frames"] = rejected_frames\n    evidence["host_after"] = host_cpu()',1)
(p/'validator.py').write_text(source)
program=(
 'import time, pathlib, base64, sys, tempfile\n'
 # Give the controller a bounded interval to identify and update this container.
 'time.sleep(10)\n'
 f"assert pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max').read_text().strip() == '{int(cores*100000)} 100000', 'CPU allocation not established'\n"
 "package_dir=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='thingdaq-sdk-')\n"
 "package_path=pathlib.Path(package_dir.name)/'thingdone_daq.zip'\n"
 f'package_path.write_bytes(base64.b64decode({encoded!r}))\n'
 'sys.path.insert(0,str(package_path))\n'
)+rig.make_program(source,settings)
(p/'rig-program.py').write_text(program); (p/'firmware.ino.hex').write_bytes(firmware); (p/'build-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
(p/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'settings':settings,'cpu_cores':cores,'hex_sha256':rig.digest(firmware),'program_sha256':rig.digest(program.encode()),'sdk_zip_sha256':rig.digest(package_bytes.getvalue())},indent=2)+'\n')
def ssh(command):
 return subprocess.run(['ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=5','bill@192.168.150.14',command],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor:
 future=executor.submit(rig.submit_program,'http://192.168.150.14:5000',Path.home().joinpath('.fw_api_key').read_text().strip(),firmware,program,p,float(seconds)+150)
 deadline=time.monotonic()+110
 changed=False
 while not future.done() and time.monotonic()<deadline:
  if (p/'start.json').exists():
   job=json.loads((p/'start.json').read_text())['test_id']
   script=f'''import docker,json,os
c=docker.from_env()
for x in c.containers.list():
 if any(m['Source'].rstrip('/').endswith('/{job}') and m['Destination']=='/storage' for m in x.attrs['Mounts']):
  before=x.attrs['HostConfig']
  x.update(cpu_quota={int(cores*100000)},cpu_period=100000)
  x.reload()
  print(json.dumps(dict(id=x.id,job='{job}',before_quota=before['CpuQuota'],after_quota=x.attrs['HostConfig']['CpuQuota'],period=x.attrs['HostConfig']['CpuPeriod'],loadavg=os.getloadavg(),cpu_count=os.cpu_count())))
'''
   response=ssh('/home/bill/.virtualenvs/remote_firmware_testing/bin/python -c '+shlex.quote(script)).strip()
   if response:
    (p/'cpu-allocation.json').write_text(response+'\n'); changed=True; print(response,flush=True);break
  time.sleep(.5)
 result=future.result()
summary=rig.classify_result(result,expected_cells=1)
(p/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
if not changed: print('Container allocation was not changed',flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if summary['outcome']=='PASS' else 1)
